Name: VMFFIX
Description: Repairs known-fixable problems in the VMF before VBSP reads it, such as reversed light falloff distances and prop_static entities using models that were not compiled with $staticprop. The fixes go into a copy that the rest of the compile uses; the map itself is never changed.
Warning: The compiled map differs from the VMF until the fixes are made in Hammer. Each fix is listed in the output.
